walkthroughs.body_html:
Formulae, Equations & Amounts — a core area of A-Level Chemistry.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Formulae, Equations & Amounts brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Formulae, Equations & Amounts.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which term is defined as: “The amount of substance containing Avogadro's number of particles.”?
Which term is defined as: “6.02 × 10²³ particles per mole.”?
Which term is defined as: “The mass of one mole of a substance in grams.”?
Which term is defined as: “Amount of solute per volume of solution (mol dm⁻³).”?
Which term is defined as: “pV = nRT, linking pressure, volume, moles and temperature.”?
Which term is defined as: “Using mole ratios to find unknown concentrations.”?
